collection.title: Chrysler Neon 1999 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Chrysler Neon 1999 - 2004 requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
